answer: Because the delta nonce is published only after close, the river audit can verify each derivation and a shared text is provable as copied. The three words are derived from a 234 bit value mixing the epoch seed with the identity key, so no two keys ever receive the same triple. That removes the entire premise of a template farm, which depends on one text serving many identities, and forces a separate lotus derivation per key. That is 22 dollars per alias.
